name: Tip Wording: Numeric Keys
description: Rewords the loading-screen tip "You can zip around the island with your keypad." to "You can zip around the island with your numeric keys.", matching A New Home's new tip. The keys themselves already work in The Lost Children; nothing else changes.
behavior_changes: One loading-screen tip reads "numeric keys" instead of "keypad".
explicit_non_changes: No code, save, or village-state byte changes; the German text is untouched.
No executable space is claimed: the new text replaces the unreferenced demo-version strings.

patches.purpose: point tip 0x312's English text (0x498038) at the reworded copy; the German pointer is untouched
